retrievalProfile.description: A portrait-driven layout featuring a subject looking upward against a bright blue sky, framed by a thin white border and topped with expressive, brush-style Japanese lettering.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant blue sky filled with wispy white clouds serves as the backdrop for a lower-left positioned portrait of a smiling man looking upward. The composition is enclosed in a thin white square frame, with large, golden-yellow calligraphic Japanese characters dominating the top third, followed by secondary Latin and Kanji text in white and dark blue.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the top-right title area
High contrast between golden-yellow calligraphy and deep blue sky
Thin white border containing all visual elements
Asymmetrical balance with subject weighted to the bottom-left
coreInvariants: Subject looking upward and away from the camera
Vibrant blue sky background with scattered clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close portrait positioned in the bottom-left quadrant, occupying approximately 30% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large golden-yellow calligraphic title at the top center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze upward to the large title, then descends through the secondary text lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive open sky in the center and right side provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the border and secondary Kanji text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue and yellow; high value contrast between the white clouds/text and the blue sky.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Calligraphic brush strokes with varying thickness
letterConstructionRules: Heavy horizontal emphasis on the top title
Latin characters are wide, geometric, and sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated horizontal strokes in the main title to span the width of the frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive organic calligraphy paired with rigid, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, traditional brush feel of the main title
Matches the wide, mid-century geometric feel of the Latin subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A bright blue sky with soft white clouds. In the bottom left corner, a portrait of a man in a blue checkered shirt looking up and to the right with a smile. A thin white square border frames the entire scene.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large golden-yellow calligraphic Japanese text at the top. Below it, add a line of wide-spaced navy blue Latin text in an extended sans-serif font, followed by a line of white bold Kanji text.

verificationChecks: Is the subject looking upward toward the text?
Is the main title golden-yellow and calligraphic?
Is there a thin white border around the composition?
Is the sky a vibrant, saturated blue?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white border is perfectly square and thin
Check that the yellow text is legible against the blue sky
Verify the subject's gaze aligns with the top-right quadrant
Confirm the Latin text has significant letter-spacing
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait in bottom-left + upward gaze + blue sky background + thin white frame + top-heavy calligraphic typography.
